releases.name: Version 1.2.1
releases.body: - Fixed death not working when holding the threader
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了在持有线轴时死亡不工作的问题

releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
- Threader improvements!
  - Reeling is a lot stronger and snappier
  - Dragging objects is more responsive and stable
  - The beam visually flexes with tension
  - Fixed some issues with using your personal tools while holding it
- Added french translation by Omega Fallon
- Adjusted the music volume
- Added snow and fog particles
- Added a lantern next to the easter egg ;3
releases.bodyZh:
- 线轴改进！
  - 收线更强力且更灵敏
  - 拖拽物体更响应且更稳定
  - 光束会随着张力在视觉上弯曲
  - 修复了在持有时使用个人工具的一些问题
- 添加了Omega Fallon提供的法语翻译
- 调整了音乐音量
- 添加了雪和雾粒子
- 在彩蛋旁边添加了一盏灯笼；3

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- Improved VR compatibility
- Somewhat fixed dragging objects
- Reverted April Fools ending to an option
releases.bodyZh:
- 提高了VR兼容性
- 一定程度上修复了拖拽物体的问题
- 将愚人节结局恢复为选项

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
Find solace in a forgotten cavern, with a device left behind.

An entry for the [third mod jam](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/modjam3/), created by Trifid and composed by chatti. (and epic playtested by Wonky Panda the epic playtester)
